trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Plan for roughly 200 hours: the story takes 60-80, the 100% checklist about 100 more. Do the one possibly missable meditation in Chapter 1 early, then play at your own pace — nothing else can be missed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — Jason's first job. It teaches the basics and ends the prologue. Story trophies unlock on their own and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Every chapter trophy pops at the end of its chapter, so just keep playing the story. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it may not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by finishing its final mission. From here on Jason and Lucia are playable together, which opens the later meditation spots.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep taking the optional missions that appear on the map as you go — there are far more than 100, and the extra ones feed the 100% checklist later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. By now the map is mostly open — use the travel time between missions to scan vehicles and study animals for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission — the end of Chapter 5 and the story. After the credits, free-roam stays open and the 100% checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, so nothing is locked away.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock in order along the main path — follow the mission markers and this one comes on its own.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so there is nothing to prepare — just play through them when they unlock.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy, it unlocks the moment the mission ends — no extra objective is needed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. There are no mission gold medals and no mission replay, so play each story mission once and move on.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport returns later for Catch Me If You Can, so learn the layout while you are here.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the late story missions — by the time it unlocks you are close to the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion), which opens after the story — progress made during the story already counts. It is the longest grind, about 100 hours after the credits, and roughly 60% of true completion: 70 of the 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and the rest of the checklist. Most of it comes from doing the other trophies, so chase this one last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind across Leonida: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. The game holds 397 stunt spots in total and the 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep jumping after this one pops — the same spots count for both.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one round of each of the 9 activity types: races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and stunts. The game tracks which types you have tried, and one round of each is enough — you do not need to win any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a range, work through its challenge list and beat each gold time or score. Slow, steady aim beats rushing — retrying a challenge costs nothing, so repeat the ones you miss until they turn gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Drone races are a map activity — fly each course once and win it; a lost race can be retried immediately.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — street, off-road, boat and air races all count, and you only need to win each race once. Pick the vehicle class you drive best and work through the race markers on the map.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Head to a fishing spot, take the challenge against Cal and land the bigger catch. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also counts toward Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and play it through to the end — any cabinet and any game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as the story advances — keep taking Andy's jobs whenever they show up. Some stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so do them as they appear rather than leaving them all for after the credits.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's stranger strand whenever his icon appears on the map — the strand ends with this mission, and finishing 8 strands in total earns Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is one of the stranger chains — follow his missions as they unlock and finish the last one to pop this trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are far more than 8 strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have one, plus more — so pick the ones you enjoy. Each strand ends with its own final mission and its own trophy.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand runs alongside the story — take his jobs when they appear and finish the last one for this trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is one of the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks — finish his last mission and count one more strand done.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The only trophy that may be missable. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and do the first one in Chapter 1, or you may lose it. After the main mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate. Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That meditation raises your counter but is not marked as a spot, and guides disagree on whether it is required — do it to be safe. The other spots are marked on the map; the last ones need Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18, so this trophy is the only one that can cost you the platinum.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Study animals through the binoculars to find the unique one Bret wants, then track and hunt it. The 100% checklist asks you to study 100 of the 255 animals, so learn the binoculars early — the same habit feeds both goals.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — pick them up as you explore and finish any 3 full sets. Cards you already own stay owned, so there is no rush: sweep an area whenever you pass through it.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations. Open WAiNK at marked spots around the state and scan each one; the counter climbs as you travel. Fold it into exploring — scan whenever you pass a new place instead of making a separate trip for it.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals listed in the Progress menu, and 70 of the 80 count toward 100% — so this trophy comes naturally while you chase A Long Road. Check the list often and pick off the easy ones first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build heat with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drop. Alleys, tunnels and switching vehicles all help — and keep your partner close, or the attempt does not count.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, hit them in quick succession and keep moving — do not stop to fight. If the wanted level drops between robberies, start the chain again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive or encounter counts, so hop into anything unfamiliar as you travel. The 100% checklist separately asks you to scan 200 of the 277 base models — use the scanner as you go and both counters climb together.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Focus — the slow-motion aim mode — in a busy fight and drop five enemies before it ends. Pick a spot with plenty of cover and plenty of targets, and do not waste the first seconds on aiming.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to Vice City International Airport, take a plane and leave without a flight plan. Expect a wanted level the moment you move — climb fast and head for open sky.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction: Rhinos are the army's tanks. Raise your wanted level until a Rhino rolls in, or find one at the military base, then deal with it — steal it or take it down. The trophy pops once you have handled one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid the cameras and the guards' sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — a failed attempt costs nothing but time.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults are the big scores — plan the approach, crack the vault, then lose the heat before the trophy counts it. Five successful escapes earn the silver, and the marked bills you take feed Dime on the Dollar.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and get away clean before the police close in. Trucks run set routes, so watch one first and pick your spot.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk the whole map — the area counter in the Progress menu shows what is left. Do it as you travel for other trophies and the last few areas become a short cleanup trip.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own rackets around Leonida — hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops. The operations are marked once you find them, so keep a note of which gangs you have done.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view until the scene triggers. Guides have not yet confirmed the exact spot — try the beachfront bars first.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's front window and out the other side. Guides have not yet confirmed the exact showroom — try the big dealerships in Vice City and keep your speed up on the way out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a full game — the follow-through is the point, so finish every frame instead of quitting early. Bowling is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one pops from a partner story moment — keep playing Lucia and Jason's story together and it comes on its own. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by guides, so do not go hunting for it: finish the story first.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make choices as they come up in missions and the open world — the game tracks them and the trophy pops once you have made enough. The exact count is not yet confirmed by guides, so just keep choosing instead of skipping past every decision.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something once, then succeed on the second try — the trophy is about the comeback. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by guides, so play naturally and it should come on its own; do not force failures on purpose.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in Leonida — a random odd event in the open world. Keep your eyes open while exploring, especially at night and off the main roads; the trophy pops when the moment finds you. The exact event is not yet confirmed by guides.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. While driving past a target, lean out and knock them down with a melee attack — a slow drive-by past foot traffic is the easiest setup. The exact setup is not yet confirmed by guides, so try it on a quiet street first.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies — bank vaults are a good source — and your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep laundering after every big score and the total climbs steadily.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, cars, weapons and food all count — every shop purchase adds to the total. Big purchases like vehicles move the needle fastest, so save this one for when you are buying cars anyway.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you earn money — buy every one of the eight to finish this trophy and give your vehicle collection a home. The purchases also count toward Treat Yo Self.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, scan a vehicle and register it — ten registrations earn the trophy. Any vehicle counts, so register the ones you drive most and the ones you discover for Whip It Good.
